title: {{NAME}} and the Rainbow Soccer Cup
moral: Kindness and teamwork make every game magical.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was practising soccer in a big green meadow. The meadow had rainbow-coloured grass and sparkly daisies. A large pink dinosaur walked over and sat down to watch. Then a golden unicorn trotted in from the trees. She had a violet horn and a silver tail. "Can I join?" asked the unicorn. This was going to be wonderful.

pages.content: The unicorn said her name was Goldie. Goldie had never played soccer. She kept tripping on her hooves. She knocked over the goal with her tail. {{NAME}} watched Goldie's sad, embarrassed face. He knew what she needed. A good friend never laughs when you are learning.

pages.content: {{NAME}} and the dinosaur set up a smaller goal just for Goldie. They showed her how to tap the ball gently. Goldie tried once. She tried again. On the third try, she flicked the ball with her front hoof. It sailed right into the goal. Her violet horn glowed bright. The meadow sparkled all around.

pages.content: They played a real match after that. Goldie used her magic horn to light up the ball. It left trails of violet sparkles across the meadow. The pink dinosaur was the goalkeeper. He blocked three big shots with his wide tail. Kindness and teamwork make every game magical. {{NAME}} felt so proud of his team.

pages.content: As the stars came out, they lay in the soft meadow grass. Goldie's horn glowed like a little lamp. The pink dinosaur snored softly.
